chunks: Salamah ibn al-Khattab, from Musa ibn Umar ibn Yazid al-Basri, from Ali ibn al-Nu'man, from Ibn Miskan, from Sulayman ibn Khalid, from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about the first one for whom a bier was made, and he said: “Fatimah, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله.”

key_terms.أَوَّلِ: the first; indicating precedence in occurrence
key_terms.النَّعْشُ: the bier or funeral couch used to carry the deceased
key_terms.فَاطِمَةُ: Fatimah, daughter of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله

ai.seo_question: Who was the first person for whom a bier was made according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the first person for whom a bier was made was Fatimah, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله. It preserves a brief historical and biographical detail connected to her burial and funeral practice.
